## Purpose

This chapter records the agreed analytical rules that sit between the registry data and BNR public statistics. It governs definitions and calculations; the workflow pages explain how analysts run those calculations.

## Documents

- **[Statistical Analysis Plan](sap.qmd):** population, event definitions, measures, comparisons, uncertainty, quality checks and disclosure principles.
- **[Metric specification register](sap-metrics.qmd):** implementation-ready definitions for each routine indicator.

## Using the framework

1. Confirm that the proposed analysis is covered by the Statistical Analysis Plan.
2. Use the metric register for the exact operational definition of an established indicator.
3. Record and approve a methodological change before altering production code.
4. Update the plan, metric register, analytical code and Public Methods Manual together when the public interpretation changes.
5. Retain the change through normal Git version history and release evidence.

The analytical code must implement the approved framework. A convenient code result does not override an agreed statistical definition.
